 SECTIONS School Holiday Tomorrow, November 16, 2026: Are schools closed for Chhath Puja? Check state-wise updates By Trending Desk , ET Online Last Updated: Nov 15, 2026, 04:59:00 PM IST Rate Story Follow us Share Font Size Abc Small Abc Medium Abc Large Save Print Comment Synopsis Schools in Delhi and Bihar will remain closed on November 16, 2026, for Chhath Puja celebrations. In contrast, schools across Himachal Pradesh and Rajasthan are expected to follow their regular schedules. Local holidays may result in school closures in various districts of Uttar Pradesh. Meanwhile, Odisha schools are anticipated to remain open without any confirmed statewide holiday. Parents and students should verify details with school administrations for accurate information.
 Agencies School Holiday Tomorrow, November 16, 2026: Are schools closed for Chhath Puja? Check state-wise updates
 Schools across several states may observe closures on Monday, November 16, 2026, due to regional festivals and local holidays. While some states have announced holidays for students, schools in other regions are expected to reopen after the festive break. Parents and students are advised to check official school notifications and state education department announcements for the latest updates on school holidays.
 School Holiday Tomorrow, November 16: State-Wise Status
 Delhi School Holiday Tomorrow 
 Schools across Delhi will remain closed on Monday, November 16, 2026, on account of Chhath Puja. The Directorate of Education (DoE), Delhi, has issued an official circular confirming the holiday for all government schools, government-aided schools and recognised unaided private schools across the national capital.
 Himachal Pradesh School Holiday Tomorrow 
Schools across Himachal Pradesh are expected to follow their regular schedules on Monday, November 16, 2026, as no statewide school holiday has been confirmed for the date.
 Uttar Pradesh School Holiday Tomorrow 
 Live Events
 Schools in several districts of Uttar Pradesh may remain closed on Monday, November 16, 2026, following local holiday announcements around Chhath Puja. However, there is no confirmation of a uniform school closure across the entire state. Students and parents in Lucknow, Noida, Kanpur and other districts should check the latest instructions issued by their respective district administrations and school authorities.
 Rajasthan School Holiday Tomorrow 
 Schools across Rajasthan are scheduled to reopen on Monday, November 16, 2026, after the extended Diwali vacation. The 12-day mid-term break, which began on November 4, will conclude on Sunday, November 15.
 West Bengal School Holiday Tomorrow 
Schools across West Bengal are expected to remain closed on Monday, November 16, 2026, as the state government’s holiday calendar lists the date as an additional holiday for Chhath Puja.
 Bihar School Holiday Tomorrow 
Yes. Government and government-aided schools across Bihar will remain closed on Monday, November 16. Students and parents should check with their respective schools for confirmation of reopening dates and any changes to the academic calendar.
 Odisha School Holiday Tomorrow 
Schools across Odisha, including Bhubaneswar, Cuttack, Puri, Rourkela, Sambalpur and Balasore, are expected to remain open on Monday, November 16, 2026, as no statewide school holiday has been confirmed for the date.
